messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Malayalam, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition (locked) | Target Requirement (Malayalam) | |-------------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------| | Ahi | Exclamation of emotional intensity | **അഹാ!** (Interjection) // literal back‑translation: “Ah!” | | quanto | Degree adverb marking “how” (extent of difficulty) | **എത്ര** (Interrogative‑degree adverb) // literal back‑translation: “how” | | a | Preposition introducing infinitive purpose (“to”) | **‑ാൻ** (Infinitive suffix attached to the verb) // literal back‑translation: “to” | | dir | Action the speaker wishes to perform (“to tell”) | **പറയ** (Verb root) + **‑ാൻ** (Infinitive) → **പറയാൻ** // literal back‑translation: “to tell” | | qual | Interrogative pronoun referring to unknown identity (“what”) | **എന്തെന്ന്** (Interrogative‑relative) // literal back‑translation: “what” | | era | Past copular verb (“was”) | **ആയിരുന്നു** (Past tense of *ആകുക*) // literal back‑translation: “was” | | è | Present copular verb (“is”) | **ആണ്** (Present tense of *ആകുക*) // literal back‑translation: “is” | | cosa | Noun denoting the referent (“thing”) | **വസ്തു** (Noun, neuter) // literal back‑translation: “thing” | | dura | Predicative adjective expressing difficulty (“hard”) – degree must be explicit | **വളരെ കഠിനമായ** (Adjective with intensifier *വളരെ* = “very”) // literal back‑translation: “hard” | | esta | Demonstrative determiner pointing to a specific forest (“this”) | **ഈ** (Demonstrative adjective) // literal back‑translation: “this” | | selva | Head noun denoting the forest/wood (“forest”) | **കാട്** (Noun) // literal back‑translation: “forest” | | selvaggia | Attribute “wild” – first in ordered list | **വന്യ** (Adjective) // literal back‑translation: “wild” | | e (1) | Coordinating conjunction linking adjectives | **മറ്റ്** (Conjunction) // literal back‑translation: “and” | | aspra | Attribute “rough” – second in ordered list | **മുറുകിയ** (Adjective) // literal back‑translation: “rough” | | e (2) | Coordinating conjunction linking adjectives | **മറ്റ്** (Conjunction) // literal back‑translation: “and” | | forte | Attribute “dense/strong” – third in ordered list | **കട്ടിയുള്ള** (Adjective) // literal back‑translation: “dense” | | che | Relative pronoun introducing clause (“which/that”) | **അത്** (Relative pronoun) // literal back‑translation: “which” | | nel | Prepositional phrase “in the” (locative) | **ചിന്തയിൽ** (Noun *ചിന്ത* + locative suffix *-യിൽ*) // literal back‑translation: “in thought” | | pensier | Noun denoting mental activity (“thought”) – already merged in *nel* | **(merged)** // literal back‑translation: “thought” | | rinova | Verb meaning “renews/recreates” – present tense | **പുനർജന്മം നൽകുന്നു** (Verb phrase with present suffix *-ുന്നു*) // literal back‑translation: “renews” | | la | Definite article specifying “the fear” (not overt in Malayalam) | **(omitted)** – Malayalam lacks articles; definiteness is understood from context // literal back‑translation: “the” | | paura | Noun denoting the emotion (“fear”) | **ഭയം** (Noun) // literal back‑translation: “fear” | | ! | Exclamation marker heightening affect | **!** (Punctuation) // literal back‑translation: “!” |
**Notes on comparative ordering & degree** - The adjectives *wild → rough → dense* appear in the exact same sequence in Malayalam (*വന്യ, മുറുകിയ, കട്ടിയുള്ള*) to preserve the ordered list. - The difficulty expressed by *dura* is rendered with an explicit degree marker **വളരെ** (“very”) before the adjective **കഠിനമായ**.
The literal back‑translation line in each *Target Requirement* cell serves as a quick check that the Malayalam rendering can be re‑translated word‑for‑word into the original English clause.

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 4: അഹാ എത്ര പറയാൻ എന്തെന്ന് ആയിരുന്നു ഇത് ഒരു വളരെ കഠിനമായ വസ്തുവാണ് / അഹാ എത്ര പറയാൻ എന്തെന്ന് ആയിരുന്നു അത് ഒരു കഠിനമായ വസ്തുവാണ് / അഹാ എത്ര പറയാൻ എന്തെന്ന് ആയിരുന്നു അത് കഠിനമായ വസ്തുവാണ് - Line 5: ഈ വന്യ മുറുകിയ കട്ടിയുള്ള കാട് / വന്യ മുറുകിയ കട്ടിയുള്ള ഈ കാട് / ഈ കാട് വന്യവും മുറുകിയതും കട്ടിയുള്ളതുമാണ് - Line 6: അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയം പുതുക്കുന്നു / ചിന്തയിൽ അത് ഭയം പുതുക്കുന്നു / ഭയം ചിന്തയിൽ പുതുക്കുന്നു

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Malayalam lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 4 Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura
**Line Inventory:** - അഹാ എത്ര പറയാൻ എന്തെന്ന് ആയിരുന്നു ഇത് ഒരു വളരെ കഠിനമായ വസ്തുവാണ്
**Assembly Notes:** - none (phrase used verbatim)
**Target Text:** അഹാ എത്ര പറയാൻ എന്തെന്ന് ആയിരുന്നു ഇത് ഒരു വളരെ കഠിനമായ വസ്തുവാണ്
---
**Source Line:** 5 esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte
**Line Inventory:** - ഈ വന്യ മുറുകിയ കട്ടിയുള്ള കാട്
**Assembly Notes:** - added copular verb **ആണ്** after the noun phrase for a complete sentence
**Target Text:** ഈ വന്യ മുറുകിയ കട്ടിയുള്ള കാട് ആണ്
---
**Source Line:** 6 che nel pensier rinova la paura!
**Line Inventory:** - അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയം പുതുക്കുന്നു
**Assembly Notes:** - appended exclamation mark to match source punctuation
**Target Text:** അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയം പുതുക്കുന്നു!

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line #: 4 Target Text: അഹാ എത്ര പറയാൻ എന്തെന്ന് ആയിരുന്നു ഇത് ഒരു വളരെ കഠിനമായ വസ്തുവാണ് Back-Translation: Ah how to say what it was this is a very hard thing Reference Translation: Ah! how hard a thing it is to tell what this … was Checks: End Punct <OK> Coverage <OK> Meaning Drift <OK> Comparative Orientation <N/A> Hallucination <OK> Corrected Target Text:
- Line #: 5 Target Text: ഈ വന്യ മുറുകിയ കട്ടിയുള്ള കാട് ആണ് Back-Translation: This wild rough dense forest is Reference Translation: this wild and rough and dense wood … Checks: End Punct <OK> Coverage <OK> Meaning Drift <OK> Comparative Orientation <N/A> Hallucination <OK> Corrected Target Text:
- Line #: 6 Target Text: അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയം പുതുക്കുന്നു! Back-Translation: It renews fear in thought! Reference Translation: which in thought renews the fear! Checks: End Punct <OK> Coverage <OK> Meaning Drift <OK> Comparative Orientation <N/A> Hallucination <OK> Corrected Target Text:
``` അഹാ എത്ര പറയാൻ എന്തെന്ന് ആയിരുന്നു ഇത് ഒരു വളരെ കഠിനമായ വസ്തുവാണ് ഈ വന്യ മുറുകിയ കട്ടിയുള്ള കാട് ആണ് അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയം പുതുക്കുന്നു! ```
